# Renewals project kickoff

Attendees: Aoife Brennan (chair), Tomasz Wielgosz, Rhys Calloway, Ellie Thornbury, Hannah Varga, Nora Kestrel

Context
- The 2027 renewal window opens **1 February 2027**. Kingsport FC and Harbour Athletic both want automatic renewal this time. Vale Rovers is not live yet, so out of scope.
- Last season 62% renewed manually and the clubs' call centres were swamped in week one.
- Target: 70% of season ticket holders on auto-renew.

Payment method
- Finance teams at both clubs do not want to reconcile direct debit mandates, and Tomasz flagged chargeback exposure on instalments.
- **Decision: season tickets are paid by card only.** Saved card (provider token) for auto-renew.

Failed payments
- **Decision: retry three times in a week** (day 1, 3, 7), then email the member, then release the seat after 14 days.

Delivery
- Project code STR27. Nora runs delivery; steering every other Tuesday.
- Hannah to build baseline renewal metrics from last season.
